answer: A practical defence is Proof of unique quarantine clearance certificate. It rests on clearances issued to one importer, season after season, which gives every honest agent a timber that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that clearances issued to one importer, season after season — so privacy survives, and the raven is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A farm doing the maths finds the tundra first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one.
